protocol.handoff_generation: BASE + retained user messages + same-run native checkpoint + prompt

limitations: Historical batches are separate runs; do not pool them as a controlled four-product comparison.
The historical Claude Code prompt batch reuses holdout fixtures with fresh compressions; it is not a new blinded holdout.
Only the native checkpoint from the same restatement run is the paired handoff baseline.
Four seeds are reused across batches; two generations per seed are not eight independent histories.
The model alias is unchanged, but server snapshots are not pinned and may drift.
Current requests add tools, request reasoning summaries, and omit the old low verbosity setting.
Current readers use different tool choice and cache options; historical handoff replay has no summary prefix.
The historical handoff prompt and current prompt differ; fixture history and base instructions are identical.
Public scalar evidence supports arithmetic review, not independent replay of private raw artifacts.
